{
  "object_type": "cabinet",
  "assumptions": [
    "对象属于 cabinet（柜体）族，但按用户要求仅表达一个无附加构件的整体长方体。",
    "整体尺寸默认为 A=600mm、B=400mm、ZZYZX=800mm。",
    "采用局部坐标原点位于柜体左后下角，X方向为宽度，Y方向为深度，Z方向为高度。",
    "GDL内部长度默认按米输入，即 A=0.6、B=0.4、ZZYZX=0.8；界面可按项目单位显示为毫米。",
    "保留一个柜体材质参数以符合可维护工程对象的基本材质要求。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "使用单个轴对齐长方体表示完整柜体。",
    "几何范围为 X=0..A、Y=0..B、Z=0..ZZYZX。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "整体柜体实体：BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX。",
    "不生成门板、侧板、顶板、底板、背板、层板、踢脚、把手或其他附加构件。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length，宽度，默认0.6m（600mm）。",
    "B：Length，深度，默认0.4m（400mm）。",
    "ZZYZX：Length，高度，默认0.8m（800mm）。",
    "mat_body：Material，整体柜体材质，使用项目默认通用柜体材质。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "材质：mat_body。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "无必要的派生尺寸；3D脚本直接使用A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "可在Master脚本中建立最小安全尺寸检查值，但不改变用户输入参数的语义。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：创建整体长方体。",
    "MATERIAL：应用mat_body材质。",
    "PROJECT2：由3D几何生成非空2D投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2：在平面中提供A、B方向的可编辑热点。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "先调用MATERIAL mat_body，再执行BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX。",
    "不使用ADD、ROT或其他变换命令，因此不存在变换栈泄漏风险。",
    "不使用FOR/NEXT，因为对象没有重复构件。",
    "A、B、ZZYZX和mat_body均直接驱动3D结果。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "使用PROJECT2生成与3D实体一致的2D投影。",
    "在PROJECT2之外可补充简单外包络或中心线，但当前简单对象以投影为主。",
    "2D脚本必须保留有效绘图命令，不允许为空。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "定义A、B、ZZYZX为Length类型，并设置0.6、0.4、0.8的默认值。",
    "定义mat_body为Material类型并设置有效默认材质。",
    "为尺寸参数设置大于零的下限和合理的工程修改范围。",
    "不增加门、层板、把手等不符合当前需求的参数。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "按“尺寸”和“材质”分组显示参数。",
    "尺寸字段使用用户指定名称A、B、ZZYZX，并配以中文说明。",
    "提供毫米语义提示，避免用户误解GDL内部米制长度。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "整体BLOCK统一使用mat_body。",
    "默认材质采用项目中可用的通用柜体或木质板材材质。",
    "不拆分前后、侧面或板件材质，因为当前对象没有独立板件。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "在2D平面中设置与A相关的X向尺寸热点，使用户可拖拽修改宽度。",
    "设置与B相关的Y向尺寸热点，使用户可拖拽修改深度。",
    "高度ZZYZX主要通过参数面板修改；如需立面编辑，可后续增加立面热点。",
    "热点位置应与对象外包络端点一致，并避免影响标准原点。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "检查A、B、ZZYZX均为正值且不小于最小安全尺寸。",
    "检查mat_body为有效材质引用。",
    "确认BLOCK尺寸始终使用A、B、ZZYZX，不能写死几何尺寸。",
    "确认2D脚本包含PROJECT2或其他有效2D绘图命令。",
    "确认脚本无未配平的ADD、ROT或其他变换命令。",
    "确认对象在默认尺寸下生成完整、无退化面和零尺寸几何。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract：对象族、主几何策略、参数表和脚本职责划分。",
    "core.generation_discipline：非空2D脚本、参数驱动几何和变换栈规则。",
    "core.parameter_rules：A、B标准尺寸参数、Length与Material类型及默认值原则。",
    "archetype.cabinet：柜体对象优先使用BLOCK表达规则。",
    "Wiki BLOCK：轴对齐长方体的基本命令与语义。",
    "Wiki PROJECT2：从3D几何生成2D投影。",
    "Wiki HOTSPOT2：2D交互编辑热点策略。"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "不同Archicad项目的GDL长度显示单位可能不同，需确认界面显示是否为毫米。",
    "若项目中不存在默认材质，mat_body可能产生材质引用警告。",
    "整体BLOCK是简化体量模型，不表达真实柜体板厚、拼接或施工节点。",
    "仅提供平面热点时，ZZYZX的图形化编辑能力弱于宽度和深度。",
    "改变对象原点约定可能影响与其他构件的定位和排布。"
  ]
}

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 0.60 ! 宽度，600mm
Length B = 0.40 ! 深度，400mm
Length ZZYZX = 0.80 ! 高度，800mm
Material mat_body = 0 ! 整体柜体材质

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! 简单长方体柜体参数校验
IF A < 0.01 THEN A = 0.01
IF B < 0.01 THEN B = 0.01
IF ZZYZX < 0.01 THEN ZZYZX = 0.01

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! 平面投影及尺寸编辑热点
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
LINE2 A, 0, A, B
LINE2 A, B, 0, B
LINE2 0, B, 0, 0

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! 简单长方体柜体
RESOL 12
MATERIAL mat_body
BLOCK A, B, ZZYZX
END

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
! 尺寸参数范围
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.01, 10.0]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.01, 10.0]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.01, 10.0]

! 材质参数使用项目材质库
VALUES "mat_body" 0

[FILE: scripts/ui.gdl]
! 尺寸参数：A=宽度，B=深度，ZZYZX=高度
! 长度参数按项目单位显示；GDL内部单位为米。
! 材质参数：mat_body=整体柜体材质

{
  "object_type": "bookshelf",
  "assumptions": [
    "构件为无门、无抽屉的开放式板式书架。",
    "A、B、ZZYZX分别表示总宽度、总深度和总高度，默认值为600mm、300mm、1200mm。",
    "n_shelves表示水平层板总数，包含底板和顶板，默认值为4。",
    "左右侧板贯通全高，层板布置在两侧板之间并沿高度方向等间距分布。",
    "暂不设置背板、踢脚、可调脚和装饰线脚，以保持基础物件便于工程继续修改。",
    "尺寸参数采用Archicad Length类型，n_shelves采用Integer类型，材质采用Material类型。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "矩形板式组合书架。",
    "左右侧板：全高、全深的竖向板件。",
    "水平层板：按n_shelves参数重复生成，包含底板和顶板。",
    "层板厚度由shelf_thk统一控制。",
    "层板净宽由总宽度减去两侧板厚度得到。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "左侧板：BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX。",
    "右侧板：BLOCK frame_thk, B, ZZYZX，并沿X方向定位。",
    "底板、顶板和中间层板：BLOCK inner_w, B, shelf_thk。",
    "层板沿Z方向按净高度均匀布置。",
    "不生成背板；后续可扩展has_back_panel和back_thk参数。"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length，总宽度，默认600mm。",
    "B：Length，总深度，默认300mm。",
    "ZZYZX：Length，总高度，默认1200mm。",
    "n_shelves：Integer，层板总数，默认4，最小值2。",
    "shelf_thk：Length，层板厚度，默认20mm，建议最小值6mm。",
    "frame_thk：Length，侧板厚度，默认20mm，建议最小值6mm。",
    "mat_body：Material，书架板件材质，默认采用通用木材或项目默认材质。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "基本尺寸：A、B、ZZYZX。",
    "层板设置：n_shelves、shelf_thk。",
    "结构设置：frame_thk。",
    "材质：mat_body。"
  ],
  "derived_parameters": [
    "_safe_A = MAX(A, 2 * frame_thk + 0.001)。",
    "_safe_B = MAX(B, 0.001)。",
    "_safe_Z = MAX(ZZYZX, 2 * shelf_thk + 0.001)。",
    "_safe_n = MAX(2, INT(n_shelves))。",
    "_inner_w = MAX(_safe_A - 2 * frame_thk, 0.001)。",
    "_usable_h = MAX(_safe_Z - shelf_thk, 0.001)。",
    "_shelf_step = _usable_h / (_safe_n - 1)。",
    "中间层板数量为MAX(_safe_n - 2, 0)，避免n_shelves小于2时循环或除零错误。"
  ],
  "command_candidates": [
    "BLOCK：表达侧板和层板等矩形板件。",
    "MATERIAL：统一设置板件材质。",
    "ADDX、ADDZ、DEL：进行板件定位并维护变换栈。",
    "FOR、NEXT：按n_shelves参数生成重复层板。",
    "PROJECT2：由3D模型生成基础2D投影。",
    "HOTSPOT2：在2D脚本中提供宽度、深度和高度的图形编辑点。",
    "RECT2、LINE2：必要时补充简化平面符号和层板线。"
  ],
  "script_3d_strategy": [
    "3D脚本按侧板、水平层板的顺序生成几何。",
    "所有板件均使用BLOCK，避免将书架错误建模为单一不可维护实体。",
    "先设置MATERIAL mat_body，确保mat_body实际驱动全部板件材质。",
    "左右侧板使用独立的ADDX定位；每个ADD或ADDX后以对应DEL配平。",
    "使用FOR i = 1 TO _safe_n循环生成层板，Z位置采用(i - 1) * _shelf_step。",
    "循环中每轮只压入必要的变换层，并在NEXT前完全DEL，避免变换栈泄漏。",
    "A、B、ZZYZX、n_shelves、shelf_thk、frame_thk和mat_body均直接或经派生参数驱动3D几何。",
    "n_shelves不足2时通过派生参数保护，避免负范围循环和除零。"
  ],
  "script_2d_strategy": [
    "基础版本采用PROJECT2 3, 270, 2生成与3D一致的平面投影。",
    "可在PROJECT2之外使用HOTSPOT2提供A、B和ZZYZX的可编辑控制点。",
    "如需工程图符号化表达，可补充RECT2绘制A×B外包络，并用FOR/NEXT绘制层板分格线。",
    "2D脚本必须保持非空，至少包含PROJECT2或有效的手工2D图元。"
  ],
  "parameter_script_strategy": [
    "在参数定义中保留Archicad标准参数A、B和ZZYZX，并严格使用用户指定名称。",
    "n_shelves定义为整数参数并限制最小值为2，避免无效结构。",
    "shelf_thk和frame_thk定义为Length参数并设置合理最小值。",
    "所有参数设置非空默认值，默认组合为A=600mm、B=300mm、ZZYZX=1200mm、n_shelves=4、shelf_thk=20mm。",
    "将参数按基本尺寸、层板设置、结构设置和材质分组，便于后续扩展。",
    "如采用参数脚本联动，应在参数变化后调用参数重建或更新相关派生值。"
  ],
  "ui_script_strategy": [
    "提供基本尺寸、层板数量、层板厚度和侧板厚度的清晰分组界面。",
    "对n_shelves显示整数输入控件，对A、B、ZZYZX、shelf_thk和frame_thk显示长度输入控件。",
    "提供mat_body材质选择控件。",
    "暂不增加背板、门板等高级选项，避免基础版本界面过度复杂。",
    "后续可增加背板开关、背板厚度和层板定位方式等扩展控件。"
  ],
  "material_strategy": [
    "使用单一mat_body材质覆盖侧板和所有层板，保证材质参数实际有效。",
    "默认材质采用项目中的通用木材、层压板或默认建筑材质。",
    "后续如需区分侧板与层板，可扩展mat_frame和mat_shelf，但当前版本避免不必要的材质参数。",
    "材质设置集中在3D脚本前部，便于工程修改和替换。"
  ],
  "hotspots_and_editability": [
    "2D中设置原点附近的固定参考热点。",
    "设置沿X方向的宽度编辑热点，使拖动结果写回A。",
    "设置沿Y方向的深度编辑热点，使拖动结果写回B。",
    "设置沿Z方向的高度编辑热点，使拖动结果写回ZZYZX。",
    "n_shelves和shelf_thk主要通过参数界面编辑；不建议用单一热点直接控制离散数量。",
    "热点位置应使用当前A、B和ZZYZX派生值，避免尺寸变化后热点脱离图形。",
    "如实现可移动层板热点，应明确其与n_shelves分布规则的关系，基础版本暂不实现。"
  ],
  "validation_checks": [
    "检查A、B和ZZYZX为正值且满足板件最小厚度要求。",
    "检查n_shelves为不小于2的整数。",
    "检查shelf_thk和frame_thk为正值。",
    "检查_inner_w大于0；当A小于两侧板厚度之和时应采用保护值或提示参数冲突。",
    "检查层板间距_shelf_step大于0。",
    "检查所有ADDX、ADDZ和ADD均有对应DEL，变换栈在脚本结束时为空。",
    "检查重复层板必须通过FOR/NEXT生成，不得手工展开。",
    "检查paramlist中的每个数值、整数和材质参数均被3D脚本或Master脚本实际引用。",
    "检查2D脚本非空，并且PROJECT2或手工2D图元能够正常生成。",
    "检查默认参数下生成4块水平层板、2块侧板，整体外包络为600mm×300mm×1200mm。"
  ],
  "knowledge_sources": [
    "core.planning_contract：对象族、板式几何、参数表和脚本职责划分。",
    "core.generation_discipline：2D非空、变换栈配平、重复几何循环化和参数驱动规则。",
    "core.parameter_rules：A、B、ZZYZX保留、Length/Integer/Material类型和默认值原则。",
    "archetype.bookshelf：书架的侧板、层板、派生净宽、FOR/NEXT和PROJECT2策略。",
    "Wiki BLOCK：矩形板件使用BLOCK表达。",
    "Wiki ADD_DEL：使用ADDX、ADDZ和DEL维护局部坐标及变换栈。",
    "Wiki FOR_NEXT：使用参数化循环生成重复层板。",
    "Wiki PROJECT2与HOTSPOT2：2D投影和图形编辑策略。"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "n_shelves的语义必须在工程中固定为包含底板和顶板的水平层板总数，否则后续使用者可能误解。",
    "若要求n_shelves表示中间可调层板数量，需要改为固定底板、顶板加n_shelves块中间层板的模型。",
    "A过小或shelf_thk、frame_thk过大时可能导致层板净宽接近零。",
    "仅使用PROJECT2时，2D图形的细节和图层表达能力有限。",
    "材质参数若未在3D脚本中调用，将违反参数驱动要求；必须确保mat_body实际参与MATERIAL设置。",
    "不同Archicad版本对参数脚本、HOTSPOT2参数引用和PROJECT2显示选项的细节可能存在兼容性差异。",
    "当前不包含背板，书籍防跌落、侧向稳定和真实制造连接细节需在后续工程版本中补充。"
  ]
}

{
  "object_type": "普通对象型单扇门（可进一步转换为墙体宿主 Door subtype）",
  "assumptions": [
    "A 表示门洞净宽，默认 900 mm；ZZYZX 表示门洞净高，默认 2100 mm。",
    "门框由左右竖框和上框组成，frame_w 表示门框在立面方向的宽度，默认 100 mm。",
    "B 作为墙体或门框沿深度方向的尺寸，默认 200 mm；panel_thk 表示门板厚度，默认 40 mm。",
    "门扇默认关闭状态，门开启方向主要通过 2D 开启符号表达；3D 中保留可扩展的开启变换接口。",
    "open_direction 使用整数枚举：1=左开，2=右开。",
    "对象原点位于门洞左下角，X 方向为门宽，Y 方向为墙厚或门扇厚度方向，Z 方向为门高。",
    "当前规划为普通可视化对象，不主动实现墙体开洞、宿主关联或 Archicad 原生门对象行为。"
  ],
  "geometry": [
    "门框外轮廓为 A+2×frame_w 宽、ZZYZX 高。",
    "左竖框：宽 frame_w、深 B、高 ZZYZX。",
    "右竖框：宽 frame_w、深 B、高 ZZYZX。",
    "上框：宽 A、深 B、高 frame_w，位于门洞顶部。",
    "门板：宽为门洞净宽 A，厚度为 panel_thk，高度为 ZZYZX；门板位于两侧门框之间。",
    "门板铰链侧根据 open_direction 镜像或调整局部坐标，以便后续扩展为可旋转开启门扇。",
    "默认不生成门槛和五金，避免引入未确认的工程参数。"
  ],
  "geometry_parts": [
    "门框左竖框",
    "门框右竖框",
    "门框上框",
    "单扇门板",
    "2D 门扇投影线",
    "2D 开启弧线和方向标识",
    "门洞外包络及可编辑热点"
  ],
  "parameters": [
    "A：Length，门宽或门洞净宽，默认 900 mm。",
    "ZZYZX：Length，门高或门洞净高，默认 2100 mm。",
    "frame_w：Length，门框立面宽度，默认 100 mm。",
    "panel_thk：Length，门板厚度，默认 40 mm。",
    "open_direction：Integer/Enum，开启方向，1=左开、2=右开，默认 1。",
    "B：Length，门框及门洞深度，默认 200 mm。",
    "mat_frame：Material，门框材质，默认木质或通用门框材质。",
    "mat_panel：Material，门板材质，默认木质或通用门板材质。"
  ],
  "parameter_groups": [
    "基本尺寸：A、ZZYZX、B",
    "构造厚度：frame_w、panel_thk",
    "开启控制：open_direction",
    "材质：mat_frame、mat_panel"

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Bookshelf Master Script
! Parameter validation and derived dimensions

IF A < 0.100 THEN A = 0.100
IF B < 0.100 THEN B = 0.100
IF ZZYZX < 0.100 THEN ZZYZX = 0.100
IF n_shelves < 2 THEN n_shelves = 2
IF shelf_thk < 0.006 THEN shelf_thk = 0.006
IF frame_thk < 0.006 THEN frame_thk = 0.006

! Required host and SEO context reads
_host_wall_thk = WALL_THICKNESS
_host_wall_h = WALL_HEIGHT
_seo_mode = GLOB_SEO_TOOL_MODE

_safe_A = MAX(A, 2 * frame_thk + 0.001)
_safe_B = MAX(B, 0.001)
_safe_Z = MAX(ZZYZX, 2 * shelf_thk + 0.001)
_safe_n = MAX(2, INT(n_shelves))

_inner_w = MAX(_safe_A - 2 * frame_thk, 0.001)
_usable_h = MAX(_safe_Z - shelf_thk, 0.001)
_shelf_step = _usable_h / (_safe_n - 1)

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Parametric open bookshelf
! Horizontal shelf count includes bottom and top shelves

RESOL 24
MATERIAL mat_body

! Left side panel
BLOCK frame_thk, _safe_B, _safe_Z

! Right side panel
ADDX _safe_A - frame_thk
BLOCK frame_thk, _safe_B, _safe_Z
DEL 1

! Bottom, intermediate, and top shelves
FOR i = 1 TO _safe_n
    ADD frame_thk, 0, (i - 1) * _shelf_step
    BLOCK _inner_w, _safe_B, shelf_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

END

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Single-leaf door with frame
! Origin: lower-left corner of the door-frame outer envelope

! Left jamb
MATERIAL mat_frame
BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX

! Right jamb
MATERIAL mat_frame
ADDX frame_w + A
BLOCK frame_w, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! Head frame
MATERIAL mat_frame
ADD frame_w, 0, ZZYZX - frame_w
BLOCK A, B, frame_w
DEL 1

! Door panel
MATERIAL mat_panel
IF open_direction = 1 THEN
    ADD frame_w, (B - panel_thk) / 2, 0
    BLOCK A, panel_thk, panel_h
    DEL 1
ELSE
    ADD frame_w + A, (B - panel_thk) / 2, 0
    MULX -1
    BLOCK A, panel_thk, panel_h
    DEL 2
ENDIF

END

_panel_y = (B - panel_thk) / 2

LINE2 frame_w + A, B, frame_w, B
LINE2 frame_w, B, frame_w, 0

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Parametric straight-run stair
! X: direction of travel, Y: stair width, Z: vertical direction

MATERIAL mat_stair

HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0
HOTSPOT 0, A, 0
HOTSPOT B, 0, 0
HOTSPOT B, A, 0
HOTSPOT 0, 0, ZZYZX

FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    ADD (i - 1) * tread_w, 0, i * riser_h
        BLOCK tread_w, A, tread_thk
    DEL 1

    IF has_riser THEN
        ADD (i - 1) * tread_w, 0, (i - 1) * riser_h
            BLOCK tread_thk, A, riser_h
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
NEXT i

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 6.000 ! 构件长度
Length ZZYZX = 0.100 ! 截面总高
Length flange_w = 0.100 ! 翼缘宽度
Length flange_t = 0.010 ! 翼缘厚度
Length web_h = 0.090 ! 翼缘上方净腹板高度
Length web_t = 0.010 ! 腹板厚度
Material mat_steel = 0 ! 钢材材质

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! L型钢构件尺寸校验与派生计算

IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF flange_w < 0.001 THEN flange_w = 0.001
IF flange_t < 0.001 THEN flange_t = 0.001
IF web_h < 0.001 THEN web_h = 0.001
IF web_t < 0.001 THEN web_t = 0.001

IF flange_t > ZZYZX THEN flange_t = ZZYZX
IF flange_w < web_t THEN flange_w = web_t

_effective_web_h = MAX (0, MIN (web_h, ZZYZX - flange_t))
_effective_total_h = _effective_web_h + flange_t
_safe_flange_w = MAX (flange_w, web_t)
_safe_flange_t = MAX (flange_t, 0.001)
_safe_web_t = MAX (web_t, 0.001)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! L型钢构件二维投影与编辑参考点

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, flange_w
HOTSPOT2 A, flange_w

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! L型钢构件三维脚本
! 构件长度沿局部X轴，截面位于YZ平面

IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF flange_w < 0.001 THEN flange_w = 0.001
IF flange_t < 0.001 THEN flange_t = 0.001
IF web_h < 0.001 THEN web_h = 0.001
IF web_t < 0.001 THEN web_t = 0.001

IF flange_t > ZZYZX THEN flange_t = ZZYZX
IF flange_w < web_t THEN flange_w = web_t

_effective_web_h = MAX (0, MIN (web_h, ZZYZX - flange_t))
_effective_total_h = _effective_web_h + flange_t
_safe_flange_w = MAX (flange_w, web_t)
_safe_flange_t = MAX (flange_t, 0.001)
_safe_web_t = MAX (web_t, 0.001)

PEN 1
MATERIAL mat_steel

! 竖向腹板
BLOCK A, _safe_web_t, _effective_total_h

! 水平翼缘，位于腹板底部并与腹板重叠
ADDY 0
ADDZ 0
BLOCK A, _safe_flange_w, _safe_flange_t
DEL 1
DEL 1

! 三维编辑参考点
HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0
HOTSPOT A, 0, 0
HOTSPOT 0, _safe_flange_w, 0
HOTSPOT 0, 0, _effective_total_h
HOTSPOT 0, _safe_web_t, _safe_flange_t

END

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.001, 100.000]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.001, 10.000]
VALUES "flange_w" RANGE [0.001, 5.000]
VALUES "flange_t" RANGE [0.001, 1.000]
VALUES "web_h" RANGE [0.001, 10.000]
VALUES "web_t" RANGE [0.001, 1.000]

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 2.000 ! 栏杆总长度
Length B = 0.100 ! 标准兼容深度和二维包络深度
Length ZZYZX = 1.100 ! 栏杆总高度
Length post_spacing = 0.120 ! 立杆目标间距
Length post_d = 0.040 ! 立杆直径
Length rail_d = 0.050 ! 扶手和底部横杆圆管直径
Boolean has_bottom_rail = 1 ! 是否生成底部横杆
Material mat_metal = 0 ! 栏杆金属材质
PenColor pen_2d = 1 ! 二维线颜色

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Railing parameter validation and derived calculations

IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001
IF B < 0.001 THEN B = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF post_spacing < 0.001 THEN post_spacing = 0.001
IF post_d < 0.001 THEN post_d = 0.001
IF rail_d < 0.001 THEN rail_d = 0.001

IF ZZYZX <= rail_d THEN
    ZZYZX = rail_d + 0.001
ENDIF

_valid_length = MAX(A, 0.001)
_valid_spacing = MAX(post_spacing, 0.001)
_spacing_divisions = INT(_valid_length / _valid_spacing)
_spacing_remainder = _valid_length - _spacing_divisions * _valid_spacing

IF _spacing_remainder > 0.000001 THEN
    n_posts = _spacing_divisions + 2
ELSE
    n_posts = _spacing_divisions + 1
ENDIF

IF n_posts < 2 THEN n_posts = 2

actual_post_spacing = _valid_length / (n_posts - 1)
top_rail_z = ZZYZX - rail_d / 2
post_height = MAX(top_rail_z, post_d)
bottom_rail_z = rail_d / 2
envelope_depth = MAX(B, MAX(post_d, rail_d))

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
PEN pen_2d
LINE_TYPE 1

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B

RECT2 0, -B / 2, A, B / 2
LINE2 0, 0, A, 0

FOR i = 1 TO n_posts
    _post_x_2d = (i - 1) * actual_post_spacing
    CIRCLE2 _post_x_2d, 0, post_d / 2
NEXT i

LINE2 0, 0, A, 0

IF has_bottom_rail THEN
    LINE2 0, 0, A, 0
ENDIF

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001
MATERIAL mat_metal

! Top handrail
ADDZ top_rail_z
ROTY 90
CYLIND A, rail_d / 2
DEL 2

! Vertical posts
FOR i = 1 TO n_posts
    _post_x = (i - 1) * actual_post_spacing
    ADDX _post_x

! 参数化单扇左铰链平开窗

! 外框
MATERIAL mat_frame

ADD 0, -frame_depth * 0.5, 0
BLOCK frame_w, frame_depth, ZZYZX
DEL 1

ADD A - frame_w, -frame_depth * 0.5, 0
BLOCK frame_w, frame_depth, ZZYZX
DEL 1

ADD frame_w, -frame_depth * 0.5, 0
BLOCK clear_w, frame_depth, frame_w
DEL 1

ADD frame_w, -frame_depth * 0.5, ZZYZX - frame_w
BLOCK clear_w, frame_depth, frame_w
DEL 1

! 剩余固定玻璃区域
IF show_glass = 1 THEN
    IF fixed_w > 0.001 THEN
        MATERIAL mat_glass
        ADD frame_w + safe_sash_w, -glass_thk * 0.5, frame_w
        BLOCK fixed_w, glass_thk, clear_h
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
ENDIF

! 开启扇局部坐标系：左侧铰链，向室外旋转
ADD frame_w, 0, frame_w
ROTZ sash_angle

! 开启扇框
MATERIAL mat_sash

ADD 0, -frame_depth * 0.5, 0
BLOCK frame_w, frame_depth, clear_h
DEL 1

ADD safe_sash_w - frame_w, -frame_depth * 0.5, 0
BLOCK frame_w, frame_depth, clear_h
DEL 1

ADD frame_w, -frame_depth * 0.5, 0
BLOCK sash_inner_w, frame_depth, frame_w
DEL 1

ADD frame_w, -frame_depth * 0.5, clear_h - frame_w
BLOCK sash_inner_w, frame_depth, frame_w
DEL 1

! 开启扇玻璃
IF show_glass = 1 THEN
    MATERIAL mat_glass
    ADD frame_w, -glass_thk * 0.5, frame_w
    BLOCK sash_inner_w, glass_thk, sash_inner_h
    DEL 1
ENDIF

DEL 2
END

! Pipe elbow master script
! Internal units are meters.

IF pipe_od < 0.001 THEN pipe_od = 0.001
IF pipe_thk < 0.0001 THEN pipe_thk = 0.0001

IF pipe_thk >= pipe_od / 2 THEN
    pipe_thk = pipe_od / 2 - 0.0001
ENDIF

IF bend_radius <= pipe_od / 2 THEN
    bend_radius = pipe_od
ENDIF

IF bend_angle < 45 THEN
    bend_angle = 45
ENDIF

IF bend_angle > 45 AND bend_angle < 90 THEN
    bend_angle = 90
ENDIF

IF bend_angle > 90 AND bend_angle < 135 THEN
    bend_angle = 135
ENDIF

IF bend_angle > 135 THEN
    bend_angle = 135
ENDIF

IF segments < 8 THEN segments = 8

pipe_ro = pipe_od / 2
pipe_ri = pipe_ro - pipe_thk
bend_r_outer = bend_radius + pipe_ro
bend_r_inner = bend_radius - pipe_ro
arc_length = bend_radius * bend_angle * PI / 180

envelope_x = bend_radius + pipe_ro
envelope_y = bend_radius * SIN (bend_angle) + pipe_ro

A = envelope_x
B = envelope_y
ZZYZX = pipe_od

Length A = 1.20 ! 单元宽度
Length B = 0.10 ! 单元厚度包络
Length ZZYZX = 3.00 ! 单元高度
Length mullion_w = 0.06 ! 竖框及横框截面宽度
Length mullion_d = 0.10 ! 竖框及横框截面深度
Length glass_thk = 0.02 ! 玻璃嵌入深度
Integer v_divs = 2 ! 竖向玻璃分格数
Integer h_divs = 3 ! 横向玻璃分格数
Material mat_frame = 0 ! 框材质
Material mat_glass = 0 ! 玻璃材质

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF mullion_w < 0 THEN mullion_w = 0
IF mullion_d < 0 THEN mullion_d = 0
IF glass_thk < 0 THEN glass_thk = 0
IF v_divs < 1 THEN v_divs = 1
IF h_divs < 1 THEN h_divs = 1

_frame_w = MIN(mullion_w, MIN(A / 2, ZZYZX / 2))
_frame_d = MAX(mullion_d, 0)
_glass_depth = MAX(glass_thk, 0)

_v_count = MAX(1, INT(v_divs))
_h_count = MAX(1, INT(h_divs))

_clear_w = MAX(A - 2 * _frame_w, 0)
_clear_h = MAX(ZZYZX - 2 * _frame_w, 0)

_bay_w = _clear_w / _v_count
_bay_h = _clear_h / _h_count

_inner_v_count = MAX(0, _v_count - 1)
_inner_h_count = MAX(0, _h_count - 1)

_glass_w = MAX(_bay_w - _frame_w, 0)
_glass_h = MAX(_bay_h - _frame_w, 0)
_glass_y = MAX((_frame_d - _glass_depth) / 2, 0)

B = MAX(_frame_d, 0.001)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
PEN 1
RECT2 0, 0, A, ZZYZX

FOR i = 1 TO _inner_v_count
    _x_grid = _frame_w + i * _bay_w
    LINE2 _x_grid, 0, _x_grid, ZZYZX
NEXT i

FOR j = 1 TO _inner_h_count
    _z_grid = _frame_w + j * _bay_h
    LINE2 0, _z_grid, A, _z_grid
NEXT j

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, ZZYZX
HOTSPOT2 A, ZZYZX

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

MATERIAL mat_frame

ADD 0, 0, 0
BLOCK _frame_w, _frame_d, ZZYZX
DEL 1

ADD A - _frame_w, 0, 0
BLOCK _frame_w, _frame_d, ZZYZX
DEL 1

ADD _frame_w, 0, 0
BLOCK _clear_w, _frame_d, _frame_w
DEL 1

ADD _frame_w, 0, ZZYZX - _frame_w
BLOCK _clear_w, _frame_d, _frame_w
DEL 1

FOR i = 1 TO _inner_v_count
    ADD _frame_w + i * _bay_w - _frame_w / 2, 0, _frame_w
    BLOCK _frame_w, _frame_d, _clear_h
    DEL 1
NEXT i

FOR j = 1 TO _inner_h_count
    ADD _frame_w, 0, _frame_w + j * _bay_h - _frame_w / 2
    BLOCK _clear_w, _frame_d, _frame_w
    DEL 1
NEXT j

MATERIAL mat_glass

FOR i = 0 TO _v_count - 1
    FOR j = 0 TO _h_count - 1
        ADD _frame_w + i * _bay_w + _frame_w / 2, _glass_y, _frame_w + j * _bay_h + _frame_w / 2
        BLOCK _glass_w, _glass_depth, _glass_h
        DEL 1
    NEXT j
NEXT i

HOTSPOT 0, 0, 0
HOTSPOT A, 0, 0
HOTSPOT 0, 0, ZZYZX

END

safe_sash_w = MIN(safe_sash_w, _max_sash_w)
fixed_w = MAX(clear_w - safe_sash_w, 0)
sash_inner_w = MAX(safe_sash_w - 2 * frame_w, 0.01)
sash_inner_h = MAX(clear_h - 2 * frame_w, 0.01)
frame_depth = MAX(B * 0.25, frame_w)

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! 窗平面符号
PEN 1
LINE_TYPE 1

! 外包络及墙体方向范围
RECT2 0, 0, A, B
LINE2 frame_w, 0, frame_w, B
LINE2 A - frame_w, 0, A - frame_w, B

! 窗框中心线
LINE2 0, B * 0.5, A, B * 0.5

! 开启扇关闭位置
LINE2 frame_w, B * 0.5, frame_w + safe_sash_w, B * 0.5
LINE2 frame_w, B * 0.5 - frame_w * 0.5, frame_w, B * 0.5 + frame_w * 0.5

! 开启扇开启位置
_openEndX = frame_w + safe_sash_w * COS(sash_angle)
_openEndY = B * 0.5 + safe_sash_w * SIN(sash_angle)
LINE2 frame_w, B * 0.5, _openEndX, _openEndY

! 开启弧线
IF show_arc = 1 THEN
    IF sash_angle > 0.001 THEN
        ! Fixed: 显式设置圆弧分段数，保证开启弧线绘制精度
        RESOL 24
        ARC2 frame_w, B * 0.5, safe_sash_w, 0, sash_angle
    ENDIF
ENDIF

! 平面图编辑热点
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 frame_w, B * 0.5
HOTSPOT2 frame_w + safe_sash_w, B * 0.5
HOTSPOT2 _openEndX, _openEndY

! Pipe elbow master script
! Internal units are meters.

IF pipe_od < 0.001 THEN pipe_od = 0.001
IF pipe_thk < 0.0001 THEN pipe_thk = 0.0001

IF pipe_thk >= pipe_od / 2 THEN
    pipe_thk = pipe_od / 2 - 0.0001
ENDIF

IF bend_radius <= pipe_od / 2 THEN
    bend_radius = pipe_od
ENDIF

IF bend_angle < 45 THEN
    bend_angle = 45
ENDIF

IF bend_angle > 45 AND bend_angle < 90 THEN
    bend_angle = 90
ENDIF

IF bend_angle > 90 AND bend_angle < 135 THEN
    bend_angle = 135
ENDIF

IF bend_angle > 135 THEN
    bend_angle = 135
ENDIF

IF segments < 8 THEN segments = 8

pipe_ro = pipe_od / 2
pipe_ri = pipe_ro - pipe_thk
bend_r_outer = bend_radius + pipe_ro
bend_r_inner = bend_radius - pipe_ro
arc_length = bend_radius * bend_angle * PI / 180

! Fixed: Calculate the complete outer bounding span of the elbow.
envelope_x = bend_radius * SIN (bend_angle) + pipe_od
! Fixed: The Y span is the centerline rise plus the complete pipe diameter.
envelope_y = bend_radius * (1 - COS (bend_angle)) + pipe_od

A = envelope_x
B = envelope_y
ZZYZX = pipe_od

Material mat_leg = 0 ! Table leg material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Circular dining table parameter validation

IF A < 0.30 THEN A = 0.30
IF ZZYZX < 0.30 THEN ZZYZX = 0.30
IF top_thk < 0.005 THEN top_thk = 0.005
IF leg_d < 0.01 THEN leg_d = 0.01
IF leg_inset < 0.01 THEN leg_inset = 0.01
IF leg_count < 3 THEN leg_count = 3

leg_count = INT (leg_count)

IF top_thk >= ZZYZX THEN
    top_thk = ZZYZX - 0.005
ENDIF

IF leg_d > A / 3 THEN
    leg_d = A / 3
ENDIF

IF leg_inset > A / 2 - leg_d THEN
    leg_inset = A / 2 - leg_d
ENDIF

IF leg_inset < 0.01 THEN
    leg_inset = 0.01
ENDIF

_leg_h = ZZYZX - top_thk
_leg_r = leg_d / 2
_table_r = A / 2
_leg_circle_r = _table_r - leg_inset - _leg_r
_leg_angle_step = 360 / leg_count

IF _leg_h < 0.005 THEN
    _leg_h = 0.005
ENDIF

IF _leg_circle_r < _leg_r THEN
    _leg_circle_r = _leg_r
ENDIF

B = A

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
RESOL 32

! Tabletop
MATERIAL mat_top
CYLIND top_thk, A / 2

! Circular legs
MATERIAL mat_leg
FOR _leg_i = 0 TO leg_count - 1
    _leg_angle = _leg_i * _leg_angle_step
    ADDX _leg_circle_r * COS (_leg_angle)
    ADDY _leg_circle_r * SIN (_leg_angle)
        CYLIND _leg_h, leg_d / 2
    DEL 2
NEXT _leg_i

END

Length A = 1.200 ! Object width and beam projection length
Length B = 0.900 ! Object depth and node envelope reference
Length ZZYZX = 0.900 ! Object height envelope
Length node_height = 0.900 ! Connection node height
Length col_hw = 0.400 ! Column web clear height
Length col_bf = 0.300 ! Column flange width
Length col_tf = 0.020 ! Column flange thickness
Length col_tw = 0.012 ! Column web thickness
Length beam_hw = 0.300 ! Beam web clear height
Length beam_bf = 0.180 ! Beam flange width
Length beam_tf = 0.016 ! Beam flange thickness
Length beam_tw = 0.010 ! Beam web thickness
Length beam_len = 0.800 ! Beam projection length
Length conn_plate_h = 0.600 ! Connection plate height
Length conn_plate_w = 0.220 ! Connection plate width
Length conn_plate_t = 0.016 ! Connection plate thickness
Length plate_offset_z = 0.000 ! Connection plate vertical offset
Integer bolt_rows = 4 ! Bolt rows along X
Integer bolt_cols = 2 ! Bolt columns along Z
Length bolt_row_spacing = 0.080 ! Bolt row spacing
Length bolt_col_spacing = 0.070 ! Bolt column spacing
Length bolt_edge_z = 0.060 ! Bolt vertical edge distance
Length bolt_edge_x = 0.050 ! Bolt horizontal edge distance
Length bolt_d = 0.022 ! Bolt diameter
Length bolt_len = 0.080 ! Bolt length
Boolean has_stiff = 1 ! Optional stiffeners
Length stiff_t = 0.012 ! Stiffener thickness
Length stiff_h = 0.220 ! Stiffener height
Length stiff_w = 0.180 ! Stiffener width
Material mat_col = 0 ! Column material
Material mat_beam = 0 ! Beam material
Material mat_plate = 0 ! Connection plate material
Material mat_bolt = 0 ! Bolt material
Material mat_stiff = 0 ! Stiffener material
Material mat_weld = 0 ! Weld material
Boolean show_bolts = 1 ! Show bolts
Boolean show_weld = 0 ! Show simplified weld geometry
Boolean show_2d_detail = 1 ! Show detailed 2D connection symbol

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! H-section column-beam connection master script

IF A < 0.1 THEN A = 0.1
IF B < 0.1 THEN B = 0.1
IF ZZYZX < 0.1 THEN ZZYZX = 0.1
IF node_height < 0.1 THEN node_height = 0.1
IF col_hw < 0.05 THEN col_hw = 0.05
IF col_bf < 0.05 THEN col_bf = 0.05
IF col_tf < 0.003 THEN col_tf = 0.003
IF col_tw < 0.003 THEN col_tw = 0.003
IF beam_hw < 0.05 THEN beam_hw = 0.05
IF beam_bf < 0.05 THEN beam_bf = 0.05
IF beam_tf < 0.003 THEN beam_tf = 0.003
IF beam_tw < 0.003 THEN beam_tw = 0.003
IF beam_len < 0.1 THEN beam_len = 0.1
IF conn_plate_h < 0.1 THEN conn_plate_h = 0.1
IF conn_plate_w < 0.05 THEN conn_plate_w = 0.05
IF conn_plate_t < 0.003 THEN conn_plate_t = 0.003
IF bolt_rows < 1 THEN bolt_rows = 1
IF bolt_cols < 1 THEN bolt_cols = 1
IF bolt_row_spacing < 0.01 THEN bolt_row_spacing = 0.01
IF bolt_col_spacing < 0.01 THEN bolt_col_spacing = 0.01
IF bolt_edge_z < 0.01 THEN bolt_edge_z = 0.01
IF bolt_edge_x < 0.01 THEN bolt_edge_x = 0.01
IF bolt_d < 0.003 THEN bolt_d = 0.003
IF bolt_len < bolt_d * 2 THEN bolt_len = bolt_d * 2
IF stiff_t < 0.003 THEN stiff_t = 0.003
IF stiff_h < 0.02 THEN stiff_h = 0.02
IF stiff_w < 0.02 THEN stiff_w = 0.02

IF col_hw < 2 * col_tf THEN col_hw = 2 * col_tf + 0.001
IF col_bf < col_tw THEN col_bf = col_tw + 0.001
IF beam_hw < 2 * beam_tf THEN beam_hw = 2 * beam_tf + 0.001
IF beam_bf < beam_tw THEN beam_bf = beam_tw + 0.001

_safe_rows = MAX (1, INT (bolt_rows))
_safe_cols = MAX (1, INT (bolt_cols))
_col_total_depth = col_hw + 2 * col_tf
_beam_total_depth = beam_hw + 2 * beam_tf
_node_h = MAX (node_height, B)
_obj_h = MAX (_node_h, ZZYZX)
_bolt_group_h = bolt_edge_z * 2 + MAX (0, _safe_cols - 1) * bolt_col_spacing
_bolt_group_w = bolt_edge_x * 2 + MAX (0, _safe_rows - 1) * bolt_row_spacing
_plate_h = MAX (conn_plate_h, beam_hw + 2 * bolt_edge_z + MAX (0, _safe_cols - 1) * bolt_col_spacing)
_plate_w = MAX (conn_plate_w, beam_bf + 2 * bolt_edge_x)
_beam_clear_depth = beam_hw + 2 * beam_tf
_stiff_h_limited = MIN (stiff_h, _plate_h / 2)
_plate_x0 = col_bf / 2
_plate_z0 = plate_offset_z - _plate_h / 2
_bolt_z0 = plate_offset_z - (_safe_cols - 1) * bolt_col_spacing / 2
_bolt_x0 = _plate_x0 + _plate_w / 2 - (_safe_rows - 1) * bolt_row_spacing / 2
_col_warning = 0
IF col_hw <= 2 * col_tf THEN _col_warning = 1
IF col_bf <= col_tw THEN _col_warning = 1
_beam_warning = 0
IF beam_hw <= 2 * beam_tf THEN _beam_warning = 1
IF beam_bf <= beam_tw THEN _beam_warning = 1

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
! H-section column-beam connection plan symbol

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 _plate_x0, plate_offset_z
HOTSPOT2 _plate_x0 + _plate_w, plate_offset_z
HOTSPOT2 _plate_x0 + _plate_w / 2, plate_offset_z + _plate_h / 2
HOTSPOT2 _plate_x0 + _plate_w / 2, plate_offset_z - _plate_h / 2

RECT2 0, -col_bf / 2, col_bf, col_bf
RECT2 _plate_x0, plate_offset_z - _plate_h / 2, _plate_w, _plate_h
LINE2 _plate_x0, plate_offset_z, _plate_x0 + _plate_w, plate_offset_z
LINE2 0, 0, beam_len, 0

IF show_2d_detail THEN
    PEN 1
    FOR i2 = 0 TO _safe_rows - 1
        FOR j2 = 0 TO _safe_cols - 1
            CIRCLE2 _bolt_x0 + i2 * bolt_row_spacing, _bolt_z0 + j2 * bolt_col_spacing, bolt_d / 2
        NEXT j2
    NEXT i2
ENDIF

PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! H-section column-beam connection node
! Local origin: column centerline and beam web centerline intersection

TOLER 0.001

GOSUB "DrawColumn"
GOSUB "DrawBeam"
GOSUB "DrawConnectionPlate"
GOSUB "DrawBolts"
GOSUB "DrawStiffeners"
GOSUB "DrawWeld"

END

"DrawColumn":
    MATERIAL mat_col
    ADD 0, 0, -_obj_h / 2
        ADD -col_tw / 2, -col_hw / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_tw, col_hw, _obj_h
        DEL 1
        ADD -col_bf / 2, -(col_hw + col_tf) / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, _obj_h
        DEL 1
        ADD -col_bf / 2, (col_hw - col_tf) / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, _obj_h
        DEL 1
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBeam":
    MATERIAL mat_beam
    ADD col_bf / 2, 0, -beam_hw / 2
        ADD 0, -beam_tw / 2, 0
            BLOCK beam_len, beam_tw, beam_hw
        DEL 1
        ADD 0, -beam_bf / 2, 0
            BLOCK beam_len, beam_bf, beam_tf
        DEL 1
        ADD 0, -beam_bf / 2, beam_hw - beam_tf
            BLOCK beam_len, beam_bf, beam_tf
        DEL 1
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawConnectionPlate":
    MATERIAL mat_plate
    ADD _plate_x0, -conn_plate_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _plate_h / 2
        BLOCK _plate_w, conn_plate_t, _plate_h
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBolts":
    IF show_bolts THEN
        MATERIAL mat_bolt
        FOR i3 = 0 TO _safe_rows - 1
            FOR j3 = 0 TO _safe_cols - 1
                ADD _bolt_x0 + i3 * bolt_row_spacing, -bolt_len / 2, _bolt_z0 + j3 * bolt_col_spacing
                    ROTX 90
                        CYLIND bolt_len, bolt_d / 2
                    DEL 1
                DEL 1
            NEXT j3
        NEXT i3
    ENDIF
RETURN

"DrawStiffeners":
    IF has_stiff THEN
        MATERIAL mat_stiff
        ADD _plate_x0, -stiff_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _stiff_h_limited / 2
            ROTX 90
                PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, 0, 0, 0, stiff_w, 0, 0, 0, _stiff_h_limited, 0
            DEL 1
        DEL 1
        ADD _plate_x0, stiff_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _stiff_h_limited / 2
            ROTX -90
                PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, 0, 0, 0, stiff_w, 0, 0, 0, _stiff_h_limited, 0
            DEL 1
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
RETURN

"DrawWeld":
    IF show_weld THEN
        MATERIAL mat_weld

! 厨房吊柜 Master Script
! 内部单位为米

IF panel_thk < 0.006 THEN panel_thk = 0.006
IF back_thk < 0.003 THEN back_thk = 0.003
IF shelf_thk < 0.006 THEN shelf_thk = 0.006
IF door_thk < 0.006 THEN door_thk = 0.006
IF n_shelves < 0 THEN n_shelves = 0
IF hinge_side < 1 THEN hinge_side = 1
IF hinge_side > 2 THEN hinge_side = 2

IF A < 2 * panel_thk + 0.001 THEN A = 2 * panel_thk + 0.001
IF B < back_thk + 0.001 THEN B = back_thk + 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 2 * panel_thk + 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 2 * panel_thk + 0.001

_inner_width = A - 2 * panel_thk
_inner_height = ZZYZX - 2 * panel_thk
_inner_depth = B - back_thk

IF _inner_width < 0.001 THEN _inner_width = 0.001
IF _inner_height < 0.001 THEN _inner_height = 0.001
IF _inner_depth < 0.001 THEN _inner_depth = 0.001

_shelf_z_step = _inner_height / (n_shelves + 1)
_door_gap = 0.002
_door_width = A - 2 * _door_gap
_door_height = ZZYZX - 2 * _door_gap

IF _door_width < 0.001 THEN _door_width = 0.001
IF _door_height < 0.001 THEN _door_height = 0.001

IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
    _hinge_x = -A / 2 + _door_gap
    _door_x = -A / 2 + _door_gap
ELSE
    _hinge_x = A / 2 - _door_gap
    _door_x = A / 2 - _door_width - _door_gap
ENDIF

_door_y = -door_thk - _door_gap

_host_wall_height = WALL_HEIGHT

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! 厨房吊柜 3D Script
! 坐标：X为宽度，Y为深度，柜体前方为Y负方向

RESOL 16

! 左侧板
MATERIAL mat_body
ADDX -A / 2
BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 右侧板
MATERIAL mat_body
ADDX A / 2 - panel_thk
BLOCK panel_thk, B, ZZYZX
DEL 1

! 底板
MATERIAL mat_body
ADD panel_thk, 0, 0
BLOCK _inner_width, B, panel_thk
DEL 1

! 顶板
MATERIAL mat_body
ADD panel_thk, 0, ZZYZX - panel_thk
BLOCK _inner_width, B, panel_thk
DEL 1

! 背板
MATERIAL mat_back
ADD panel_thk, B - back_thk, panel_thk
BLOCK _inner_width, back_thk, _inner_height
DEL 1

! 内部层板
MATERIAL mat_body
FOR i = 1 TO n_shelves
    ADD panel_thk, 0, panel_thk + i * _shelf_z_step - shelf_thk / 2
    BLOCK _inner_width, _inner_depth, shelf_thk
    DEL 1
NEXT i

! 柜门
IF has_door THEN
    MATERIAL mat_door
    ADD _door_x, _door_y, _door_gap
    BLOCK _door_width, door_thk, _door_height
    DEL 1
ENDIF

END

! 厨房吊柜 2D Script

PEN 1
RESOL 16

! 外包络及编辑热点
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, 0
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, 0
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, B
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, B

! 基础三维投影
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

! 柜体前沿
LINE2 -A / 2, 0, A / 2, 0

! 背部边界
LINE2 -A / 2, B, A / 2, B

! 开放柜体的层板示意
IF has_door = 0 THEN
    FOR i = 1 TO n_shelves
        _plan_shelf_y = i * B / (n_shelves + 1)
        LINE2 -_inner_width / 2, _plan_shelf_y, _inner_width / 2, _plan_shelf_y
    NEXT i
ENDIF

! 有门时绘制门扇边界及方向性开启符号
IF has_door THEN
    LINE2 -A / 2 + _door_gap, -_door_gap, A / 2 - _door_gap, -_door_gap
    LINE2 -A / 2 + _door_gap, -_door_gap, -A / 2 + _door_gap, -_door_gap - _door_width
    LINE2 A / 2 - _door_gap, -_door_gap, A / 2 - _door_gap, -_door_gap - _door_width

    IF hinge_side = 1 THEN
        LINE2 -A / 2 + _door_gap, -_door_gap, 0, -_door_width
        ARC2 -A / 2 + _door_gap, -_door_gap, _door_width, 270, 360
    ELSE
        LINE2 A / 2 - _door_gap, -_door_gap, 0, -_door_width
        ARC2 A / 2 - _door_gap, -_door_gap, _door_width, 180, 270
    ENDIF
ENDIF

"DrawColumn":
    MATERIAL mat_col
    ADD 0, 0, -_obj_h / 2
        ADD -col_tw / 2, -col_hw / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_tw, col_hw, _obj_h
        DEL 1
        ADD -col_bf / 2, -(col_hw + col_tf) / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, _obj_h
        DEL 1
        ADD -col_bf / 2, (col_hw - col_tf) / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, _obj_h
        DEL 1
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBeam":
    MATERIAL mat_beam
    ADD col_bf / 2, 0, -beam_hw / 2
        ADD 0, -beam_tw / 2, 0
            BLOCK beam_len, beam_tw, beam_hw
        DEL 1
        ADD 0, -beam_bf / 2, 0
            BLOCK beam_len, beam_bf, beam_tf
        DEL 1
        ADD 0, -beam_bf / 2, beam_hw - beam_tf
            BLOCK beam_len, beam_bf, beam_tf
        DEL 1
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawConnectionPlate":
    MATERIAL mat_plate
    ADD _plate_x0, -conn_plate_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _plate_h / 2
        BLOCK _plate_w, conn_plate_t, _plate_h
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBolts":
    IF show_bolts THEN
        MATERIAL mat_bolt
        ! Fixed: i3 and j3 are declared in paramlist.xml for the nested bolt loops
        FOR i3 = 0 TO _safe_rows - 1
            FOR j3 = 0 TO _safe_cols - 1
                ADD _bolt_x0 + i3 * bolt_row_spacing, -bolt_len / 2, _bolt_z0 + j3 * bolt_col_spacing
                    ROTX 90
                        CYLIND bolt_len, bolt_d / 2
                    DEL 1
                DEL 1
            NEXT j3
        NEXT i3
    ENDIF
RETURN

"DrawStiffeners":

        MATERIAL mat_stiff
        ADD _plate_x0, -stiff_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _stiff_h_limited / 2
            ROTX 90
                PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, 0, 0, 0, stiff_w, 0, 0, 0, _stiff_h_limited, 0
            DEL 1
        DEL 1
        ADD _plate_x0, stiff_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _stiff_h_limited / 2
            ROTX -90
                PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, 0, 0, 0, stiff_w, 0, 0, 0, _stiff_h_limited, 0
            DEL 1
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
RETURN

"DrawWeld":

        MATERIAL mat_weld
        ADD _plate_x0 - conn_plate_t / 2, -conn_plate_t / 2, plate_offset_z - beam_hw / 2
            BLOCK conn_plate_t, conn_plate_t, beam_hw
        DEL 1
    ENDIF

! Turned railing post master script

IF A < 0.001 THEN A = 0.001
IF B < 0.001 THEN B = 0.001
IF ZZYZX < 0.001 THEN ZZYZX = 0.001
IF base_d < 0.001 THEN base_d = 0.001
IF top_d < 0.001 THEN top_d = 0.001

seg_count = ROUND(seg_count)
IF seg_count < 1 THEN seg_count = 1
IF seg_count > 12 THEN seg_count = 12

safe_height = ZZYZX
safe_base_d = base_d
safe_top_d = top_d
safe_seg_count = seg_count
segment_h = safe_height / safe_seg_count

max_profile_d = MAX(safe_base_d, safe_top_d)

FOR i = 1 TO safe_seg_count
    t_mid = (i - 0.5) / safe_seg_count
    linear_d = safe_base_d + (safe_top_d - safe_base_d) * t_mid
    bulge_factor = 1 + 0.10 * (1 - ABS(2 * t_mid - 1))
    profile_d = linear_d * bulge_factor
    max_profile_d = MAX(max_profile_d, profile_d)
NEXT i

IF max_profile_d < 0.001 THEN max_profile_d = 0.001

xy_scale = MIN(A, B) / max_profile_d
IF xy_scale <= 0 THEN xy_scale = 1

plan_radius = max_profile_d * xy_scale / 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
! Turned wooden railing post
! Origin at the center of the post foot

TOLER 0.002
MATERIAL mat_body

_profile_count = 2 + safe_seg_count * 3

PUT 0, 0, 0

FOR i = 1 TO safe_seg_count
    _z0 = (i - 1) * segment_h
    _zmid = (i - 0.5) * segment_h
    _z1 = i * segment_h

    _t0 = (i - 1) / safe_seg_count
    _tmid = (i - 0.5) / safe_seg_count
    _t1 = i / safe_seg_count

    _d0 = safe_base_d + (safe_top_d - safe_base_d) * _t0
    _dmid = safe_base_d + (safe_top_d - safe_base_d) * _tmid
    _d1 = safe_base_d + (safe_top_d - safe_base_d) * _t1

    _bulge0 = 1 + 0.10 * (1 - ABS(2 * _t0 - 1))
    _bulgemid = 1 + 0.10 * (1 - ABS(2 * _tmid - 1))
    _bulge1 = 1 + 0.10 * (1 - ABS(2 * _t1 - 1))

    _r0 = _d0 * _bulge0 / 2
    _rmid = _dmid * _bulgemid / 2
    _r1 = _d1 * _bulge1 / 2

    PUT _r0, _z0, 0.18
    PUT _rmid, _zmid, 0.32
    PUT _r1, _z1, 0.18
NEXT i

PUT 0, safe_height, 0

MUL xy_scale, 1, 1
ROTX 90
REVOLVE_ _profile_count, 360, mat_top, mat_body, mat_top, 63, GET(NSP)
DEL 2

END

IF bolt_cols < 1 THEN bolt_cols = 1

IF bolt_col_spacing < 0.01 THEN bolt_col_spacing = 0.01
IF bolt_edge_z < 0.01 THEN bolt_edge_z = 0.01
IF bolt_edge_x < 0.01 THEN bolt_edge_x = 0.01
IF bolt_d < 0.003 THEN bolt_d = 0.003
IF bolt_len < bolt_d * 2 THEN bolt_len = bolt_d * 2

_safe_cols = MAX (1, INT (bolt_cols))

! H-section column-beam connection plan symbol

HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 _plate_x0, plate_offset_z
HOTSPOT2 _plate_x0 + _plate_w, plate_offset_z
HOTSPOT2 _plate_x0 + _plate_w / 2, plate_offset_z + _plate_h / 2
HOTSPOT2 _plate_x0 + _plate_w / 2, plate_offset_z - _plate_h / 2

RECT2 0, -col_bf / 2, col_bf, col_bf
RECT2 _plate_x0, plate_offset_z - _plate_h / 2, _plate_w, _plate_h
LINE2 _plate_x0, plate_offset_z, _plate_x0 + _plate_w, plate_offset_z

    PEN 1
    FOR i2 = 0 TO _safe_rows - 1
        FOR j2 = 0 TO _safe_cols - 1
            ! Fixed: use the explicit derived bolt column spacing and edge-distance values.
            ARC2 _bolt_x0 + i2 * bolt_row_spacing, _bolt_z0 + j2 * _bolt_z_step, bolt_d / 2, 0, 360    ! [LINTER-FIXED RULE-002]

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
! H-section column-beam connection node
! Local origin: column centerline and beam web centerline intersection

TOLER 0.001

GOSUB "DrawColumn"
GOSUB "DrawBeam"
GOSUB "DrawConnectionPlate"
GOSUB "DrawBolts"
GOSUB "DrawStiffeners"
GOSUB "DrawWeld"

END

"DrawColumn":
    MATERIAL mat_col
    ADD 0, 0, -_obj_h / 2
        ADD -col_tw / 2, -_col_hw_draw / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_tw, _col_hw_draw, _obj_h
        DEL 1
        ADD -col_bf / 2, -(_col_hw_draw + col_tf) / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, _obj_h
        DEL 1
        ADD -col_bf / 2, (_col_hw_draw - col_tf) / 2, 0
            BLOCK col_bf, col_tf, _obj_h
        DEL 1
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBeam":
    MATERIAL mat_beam
    ADD col_bf / 2, 0, -beam_hw / 2
        ADD 0, -beam_tw / 2, 0
            ! Fixed: use the A-responsive effective beam length.
            BLOCK _beam_draw_len, beam_tw, beam_hw
        DEL 1
        ADD 0, -beam_bf / 2, 0
            BLOCK _beam_draw_len, beam_bf, beam_tf
        DEL 1
        ADD 0, -beam_bf / 2, beam_hw - beam_tf
            BLOCK _beam_draw_len, beam_bf, beam_tf
        DEL 1
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawConnectionPlate":
    MATERIAL mat_plate
    ADD _plate_x0, -conn_plate_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _plate_h / 2
        BLOCK _plate_w, conn_plate_t, _plate_h
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawBolts":
    IF show_bolts THEN
        MATERIAL mat_bolt
        FOR i3 = 0 TO _safe_rows - 1
            FOR j3 = 0 TO _safe_cols - 1
                ! Fixed: use the explicit derived bolt column spacing and edge-distance values.
                ADD _bolt_x0 + i3 * bolt_row_spacing, -bolt_len / 2, _bolt_z0 + j3 * _bolt_z_step
                    ROTX 90
                        CYLIND bolt_len, bolt_d / 2
                    DEL 1
                DEL 1
            NEXT j3
        NEXT i3
    ENDIF
RETURN

"DrawStiffeners":
    IF has_stiff THEN
        MATERIAL mat_stiff
        ADD _plate_x0, -stiff_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _stiff_h_limited / 2
            ROTX 90
                PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, 0, 0, 0, stiff_w, 0, 0, 0, _stiff_h_limited, 0
            DEL 1
        DEL 1
        ADD _plate_x0, stiff_t / 2, plate_offset_z - _stiff_h_limited / 2
            ROTX -90
                PRISM_ 3, stiff_t, 0, 0, 0, stiff_w, 0, 0, 0, _stiff_h_limited, 0
            DEL 1
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
RETURN

"DrawWeld":
    IF show_weld THEN
        MATERIAL mat_weld
        ADD _plate_x0 - conn_plate_t / 2, -conn_plate_t / 2, plate_offset_z - beam_hw / 2
            BLOCK conn_plate_t, conn_plate_t, beam_hw
        DEL 1
    ENDIF
RETURN

! Turned wooden railing post
! Origin at the center of the post foot

TOLER 0.002
MATERIAL mat_body

_profile_count = 2 + safe_seg_count * 3

! Fixed: replace dynamic REVOLVE_ profile submission with explicit cone segments so preview generates valid mesh
MUL xy_scale, xy_scale, 1

FOR i = 1 TO safe_seg_count
    _z0 = (i - 1) * segment_h
    _zmid = (i - 0.5) * segment_h
    _z1 = i * segment_h

    _t0 = (i - 1) / safe_seg_count
    _tmid = (i - 0.5) / safe_seg_count
    _t1 = i / safe_seg_count

    _d0 = safe_base_d + (safe_top_d - safe_base_d) * _t0
    _dmid = safe_base_d + (safe_top_d - safe_base_d) * _tmid
    _d1 = safe_base_d + (safe_top_d - safe_base_d) * _t1

    _bulge0 = 1 + 0.10 * (1 - ABS(2 * _t0 - 1))
    _bulgemid = 1 + 0.10 * (1 - ABS(2 * _tmid - 1))
    _bulge1 = 1 + 0.10 * (1 - ABS(2 * _t1 - 1))

    _r0 = _d0 * _bulge0 / 2
    _rmid = _dmid * _bulgemid / 2
    _r1 = _d1 * _bulge1 / 2

    ADDZ _z0
    CONE segment_h / 2, _r0, _rmid, 360
    DEL 1

    ADDZ _zmid
    IF i = safe_seg_count THEN MATERIAL mat_top
    CONE segment_h / 2, _rmid, _r1, 360
    DEL 1

    IF i < safe_seg_count THEN MATERIAL mat_body
NEXT i

DEL 1

END

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 6.000 ! Total span
Length B = 0.150 ! Outside spacing between parallel trusses
Length ZZYZX = 1.200 ! Truss height
Integer panel_count = 4 ! Number of triangular panels
Length chord_d = 0.060 ! Outside diameter of all tubular members
Material mat_steel = 0 ! Steel material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
! Warren truss validation and derived dimensions

IF A < 0.100 THEN A = 0.100
IF B < 0.000 THEN B = 0.000
IF ZZYZX < 0.100 THEN ZZYZX = 0.100
IF chord_d < 0.010 THEN chord_d = 0.010
IF panel_count < 1 THEN panel_count = 1

IF ZZYZX <= chord_d THEN
    ZZYZX = chord_d * 1.10
ENDIF

IF A / panel_count <= chord_d THEN
    A = chord_d * panel_count * 1.10
ENDIF

_panel_pitch = A / panel_count
_tube_r = chord_d / 2
_diagonal_len = SQR((_panel_pitch / 2) * (_panel_pitch / 2) + ZZYZX * ZZYZX)

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl
VALUES "A" RANGE [0.100, 100.000]
VALUES "B" RANGE [0.000, 10.000]
VALUES "ZZYZX" RANGE [0.100, 20.000]
VALUES "panel_count" RANGE [1, 100]
VALUES "chord_d" RANGE [0.010, 1.000]
VALUES "mat_steel"

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
HOTSPOT2 0, ZZYZX
HOTSPOT2 A, ZZYZX
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl
! Parametric double Warren truss
! The local cylinder axis is transformed from Z to each member vector

PEN 1
MATERIAL mat_steel
TOLER 0.001

_panel_pitch = A / panel_count
_tube_r = chord_d / 2

! First parallel truss
_truss_y = -B / 2

FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
    _x1 = _i * _panel_pitch
    _x2 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch
    _y1 = _truss_y
    _y2 = _truss_y
    _z1 = 0
    _z2 = 0
    GOSUB "DrawRod"
NEXT _i

FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
    _x1 = _i * _panel_pitch
    _x2 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch
    _y1 = _truss_y
    _y2 = _truss_y
    _z1 = ZZYZX
    _z2 = ZZYZX
    GOSUB "DrawRod"
NEXT _i

FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
    _bottom_x = _i * _panel_pitch
    _top_x = (_i + 0.5) * _panel_pitch

    _x1 = _bottom_x
    _x2 = _top_x
    _y1 = _truss_y
    _y2 = _truss_y
    _z1 = 0
    _z2 = ZZYZX
    GOSUB "DrawRod"

    _x1 = _top_x
    _x2 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch
    _y1 = _truss_y
    _y2 = _truss_y
    _z1 = ZZYZX
    _z2 = 0
    GOSUB "DrawRod"
NEXT _i

! Second parallel truss and transverse node ties
IF B > 0.001 THEN
    _truss_y = B / 2

    FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
        _x1 = _i * _panel_pitch
        _x2 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch
        _y1 = _truss_y
        _y2 = _truss_y
        _z1 = 0
        _z2 = 0
        GOSUB "DrawRod"
    NEXT _i

    FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
        _x1 = _i * _panel_pitch
        _x2 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch
        _y1 = _truss_y
        _y2 = _truss_y
        _z1 = ZZYZX
        _z2 = ZZYZX
        GOSUB "DrawRod"
    NEXT _i

    FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
        _bottom_x = _i * _panel_pitch
        _top_x = (_i + 0.5) * _panel_pitch

        _x1 = _bottom_x
        _x2 = _top_x
        _y1 = _truss_y
        _y2 = _truss_y
        _z1 = 0
        _z2 = ZZYZX
        GOSUB "DrawRod"

        _x1 = _top_x
        _x2 = (_i + 1) * _panel_pitch
        _y1 = _truss_y
        _y2 = _truss_y
        _z1 = ZZYZX
        _z2 = 0
        GOSUB "DrawRod"
    NEXT _i

    ! Bottom transverse ties
    FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count
        _x1 = _i * _panel_pitch
        _x2 = _i * _panel_pitch
        _y1 = -B / 2
        _y2 = B / 2
        _z1 = 0
        _z2 = 0
        GOSUB "DrawRod"
    NEXT _i

    ! Upper transverse ties at triangular-panel apex nodes
    FOR _i = 0 TO panel_count - 1
        _x1 = (_i + 0.5) * _panel_pitch
        _x2 = (_i + 0.5) * _panel_pitch
        _y1 = -B / 2
        _y2 = B / 2
        _z1 = ZZYZX
        _z2 = ZZYZX
        GOSUB "DrawRod"
    NEXT _i
ENDIF

END

"DrawRod":
    _dx = _x2 - _x1
    _dy = _y2 - _y1
    _dz = _z2 - _z1
    _horizontal = SQR(_dx * _dx + _dy * _dy)
    _rod_len = SQR(_horizontal * _horizontal + _dz * _dz)

    IF _rod_len > 0.0001 THEN
        _azimuth = 0
        IF _horizontal > 0.0001 THEN
            IF ABS(_dx) > 0.0001 THEN
                _azimuth = ATN(_dy / _dx)
                IF _dx < 0 THEN
                    _azimuth = _azimuth + 180
                ENDIF
            ELSE
                IF _dy >= 0 THEN
                    _azimuth = 90
                ELSE
                    _azimuth = -90
                ENDIF
            ENDIF
        ENDIF

        _tilt = 0
        IF _horizontal > 0.0001 THEN
            IF ABS(_dz) > 0.0001 THEN
                _tilt = ATN(_horizontal / ABS(_dz))
            ELSE
                _tilt = 90
            ENDIF
            IF _dz < 0 THEN
                _azimuth = _azimuth + 180
            ENDIF
        ENDIF

        ADD _x1, _y1, _z1
        ROTY _tilt
        ROTZ _azimuth
        CYLIND _rod_len, _tube_r
        DEL 3
    ENDIF
RETURN

Boolean show_tread_edges = 1 ! Show tread edge lines in 2D

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.30 THEN A = 0.30
IF B < 0.30 THEN B = 0.30
IF stair_steps < 3 THEN stair_steps = 3
IF riser_h <= 0 THEN riser_h = 0.18
IF post_d <= 0 THEN post_d = 0.20
IF tread_thk <= 0 THEN tread_thk = 0.04
IF tread_w <= 0 THEN tread_w = 0.05
IF total_angle = 0 THEN total_angle = 15
IF total_angle < -1440 THEN total_angle = -1440
IF total_angle > 1440 THEN total_angle = 1440
IF total_angle > -15 AND total_angle < 0 THEN total_angle = -15
IF total_angle > 0 AND total_angle < 15 THEN total_angle = 15

total_height = stair_steps * riser_h
step_angle = total_angle / stair_steps
outer_rx = A / 2
outer_ry = B / 2
inner_r = post_d / 2
available_radial_w = MIN(outer_rx, outer_ry) - inner_r
effective_tread_w = MIN(tread_w, available_radial_w)
IF effective_tread_w < 0.001 THEN effective_tread_w = 0.001
tread_outer_rx = inner_r + effective_tread_w
tread_tangential_len = 2 * tread_outer_rx * SIN(step_angle / 2)
safe_tread_tangential_len = MAX(tread_tangential_len, tread_thk)

IF total_height + tread_thk > ZZYZX THEN ZZYZX = total_height + tread_thk

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

IF show_post THEN
    MATERIAL mat_post
    CYLIND total_height + tread_thk, post_d / 2
ENDIF

MATERIAL mat_tread

FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    ADDZ (i - 1) * riser_h
    ROT 0, 0, 1, (i - 1) * step_angle
    ADD inner_r, -safe_tread_tangential_len / 2, 0
    BLOCK effective_tread_w, safe_tread_tangential_len, tread_thk
    DEL 1
    DEL 1
NEXT i

END

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, -B / 2
HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 0, 0

IF show_post THEN
    CIRCLE2 0, 0, post_d / 2
ENDIF

IF show_tread_edges THEN
    FOR i2 = 0 TO stair_steps - 1
        LINE2 inner_r * COS(i2 * step_angle), inner_r * SIN(i2 * step_angle), tread_outer_rx * COS(i2 * step_angle), tread_outer_rx * SIN(i2 * step_angle)
    NEXT i2
ENDIF

IF A < 0.01 THEN A = 0.01
IF B < 0.01 THEN B = 0.01

IF frame_w < 0.005 THEN frame_w = 0.005

_halfA = A / 2
_halfB = B / 2
_safeH = ZZYZX

_slopeA = SQR(_halfA * _halfA + _safeH * _safeH)
_slopeB = SQR(_halfB * _halfB + _safeH * _safeH)

_angleB = ATN(_safeH / _halfB)

_panelB = MAX(glass_thk, 0.001)

_cornerSlope = SQR(_diag * _diag + _safeH * _safeH)
_cornerAzimuth = ATN(_halfB / _halfA)
_cornerTilt = ATN(_safeH / _diag)

_bottomFrameW = MIN(frame_w, MIN(A, B) * 0.25)
_bottomFrameD = MIN(frame_d, MIN(A, B) * 0.25)
_slopeFrameW = MIN(frame_w, MIN(_slopeA, _slopeB) * 0.25)
_slopeFrameD = MIN(frame_d, MIN(_slopeA, _slopeB) * 0.25)

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

MATERIAL mat_glass
GOSUB "DrawGlassPanels"

IF show_frame THEN
    MATERIAL mat_frame
    GOSUB "DrawBottomFrames"
    GOSUB "DrawSlopeFrames"
    GOSUB "DrawTopNode"
ENDIF

END

"DrawGlassPanels":
    ADD 0, -_halfB, 0
    ROTX _angleB
    PRISM_ 3, _panelA, -_halfA, 0, 0, _halfA, 0, 0, 0, _slopeB, 0
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, _halfB, 0
    ROTX -_angleB
    PRISM_ 3, _panelA, -_halfA, 0, 0, _halfA, 0, 0, 0, _slopeB, 0
    DEL 1

    ADD _halfA, 0, 0
    ROTZ 90
    ROTY _angleA
    PRISM_ 3, _panelB, -_halfB, 0, 0, _halfB, 0, 0, 0, _slopeA, 0
    DEL 2

    ADD -_halfA, 0, 0
    ROTZ -90
    ROTY _angleA
    PRISM_ 3, _panelB, -_halfB, 0, 0, _halfB, 0, 0, 0, _slopeA, 0
    DEL 2
RETURN

"DrawBottomFrames":
    ADD 0, -_halfB, _bottomFrameW / 2
    ROTZ 0
    BLOCK A, _bottomFrameD, _bottomFrameW
    DEL 1

    ADD 0, _halfB, _bottomFrameW / 2
    ROTZ 0
    BLOCK A, _bottomFrameD, _bottomFrameW
    DEL 1

    ADD -_halfA, 0, _bottomFrameW / 2
    ROTZ 90
    BLOCK B, _bottomFrameD, _bottomFrameW
    DEL 1

    ADD _halfA, 0, _bottomFrameW / 2
    ROTZ 90
    BLOCK B, _bottomFrameD, _bottomFrameW
    DEL 1
RETURN

"DrawSlopeFrames":
    ADD -_halfA, -_halfB, _safeH / 2
    ROTZ _cornerAzimuth
    ROTY _cornerTilt
    BLOCK _cornerSlope, _slopeFrameD, _slopeFrameW
    DEL 2

    ADD _halfA, -_halfB, _safeH / 2
    ROTZ 180 - _cornerAzimuth
    ROTY _cornerTilt
    BLOCK _cornerSlope, _slopeFrameD, _slopeFrameW
    DEL 2

    ADD _halfA, _halfB, _safeH / 2
    ROTZ 180 + _cornerAzimuth
    ROTY _cornerTilt
    BLOCK _cornerSlope, _slopeFrameD, _slopeFrameW
    DEL 2

    ADD -_halfA, _halfB, _safeH / 2
    ROTZ 360 - _cornerAzimuth
    ROTY _cornerTilt
    BLOCK _cornerSlope, _slopeFrameD, _slopeFrameW
    DEL 2
RETURN

"DrawTopNode":
    ADD 0, 0, _safeH - _slopeFrameW / 2
    BLOCK frame_w * 1.5, frame_d * 1.5, _slopeFrameW
    DEL 1
RETURN

! Steel beam parameter validation and bolt-array calculation

_safe_A = MAX (A, 0.20)
_safe_B = MAX (B, 0.05)
_safe_Z = MAX (ZZYZX, 0.05)

_safe_count = INT (hole_count)
IF _safe_count < 1 THEN
    _safe_count = 1
ENDIF
IF _safe_count > 1000 THEN
    _safe_count = 1000
ENDIF

_safe_d = MIN (MAX (hole_d, 0.002), MIN (_safe_B, _safe_Z) - 0.010)
IF _safe_d < 0.002 THEN
    _safe_d = 0.002
ENDIF
_hole_radius = _safe_d / 2

_min_edge_clearance = MAX (_safe_d, 0.05)
_hold_edge_left = _min_edge_clearance
_hold_edge_right = _min_edge_clearance

_max_span = MAX (_safe_A - _hold_edge_left - _hold_edge_right, 0.001)

_requested_spacing = hole_spacing
IF _requested_spacing < 0.001 THEN
    _requested_spacing = 0.05
ENDIF

IF _safe_count = 1 THEN
    _actual_spacing = 0
ELSE
    _actual_spacing = MIN (_requested_spacing, _max_span / (_safe_count - 1))
ENDIF

_array_span = (_safe_count - 1) * _actual_spacing
_start_x = -_array_span / 2

HOTSPOT2 -A / 2, B / 2
HOTSPOT2 A / 2, B / 2

FOR i = 1 TO _safe_count
    _hole_x = _start_x + (i - 1) * _actual_spacing
    CIRCLE2 _hole_x, 0, _hole_radius
NEXT i

[FILE: paramlist.xml]
Length A = 1.00 ! Standard ArchiCAD width compatibility parameter
Length B = 1.00 ! Standard ArchiCAD depth compatibility parameter
Length ZZYZX = 1.00 ! Standard ArchiCAD height compatibility parameter
Length node_r = 0.180 ! Spherical node diameter
Integer strut_count = 6 ! Number of radial struts
Length strut_d = 0.060 ! Strut diameter
Length strut_length = 0.300 ! Strut length extending outside the node
Material node_material = "Steel" ! Node material
Material strut_material = "Steel" ! Strut material

[FILE: scripts/1d.gdl]
IF node_r < 0.010 THEN node_r = 0.010
IF strut_d < 0.005 THEN strut_d = 0.005
IF strut_length < 0.010 THEN strut_length = 0.010
IF strut_count < 1 THEN strut_count = 1
strut_count = INT(strut_count)

[FILE: scripts/vl.gdl]
VALUES "node_r" RANGE [0.010, 2.000]
VALUES "strut_count" RANGE [1, 200]
VALUES "strut_d" RANGE [0.005, 0.500]
VALUES "strut_length" RANGE [0.010, 5.000]
HIDEPARAMETER "A"
HIDEPARAMETER "B"
HIDEPARAMETER "ZZYZX"
LOCK "A", "B", "ZZYZX"

[FILE: scripts/2d.gdl]
HOTSPOT2 0, 0
HOTSPOT2 A, 0
HOTSPOT2 0, B
HOTSPOT2 A, B
CIRCLE2 0, 0, node_r / 2
PROJECT2 3, 270, 2

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

_node_radius = node_r / 2
_strut_radius = strut_d / 2
_overlap_depth = _node_radius * 0.20
_strut_start = _node_radius - _overlap_depth
_strut_axis_length = strut_length + _overlap_depth

MATERIAL node_material
SPHERE _node_radius

MATERIAL strut_material
FOR _i = 1 TO strut_count
    _z = 1 - 2 * (_i - 0.5) / strut_count
    _radial = SQR(MAX(0, 1 - _z * _z))
    _azimuth = 137.507764 * (_i - 1)
    _dir_x = _radial * COS(_azimuth)
    _dir_y = _radial * SIN(_azimuth)
    _dir_z = _z
    _pitch = ACS(_dir_z)

    ADD _dir_x * _strut_start, _dir_y * _strut_start, _dir_z * _strut_start
    ROTZ _azimuth
    ROTY _pitch
    CYLIND _strut_axis_length, _strut_radius
    DEL 3
NEXT _i

END

[FILE: 1d.gdl]
IF A < 0.30 THEN A = 0.30
IF B < 0.30 THEN B = 0.30
IF stair_steps < 3 THEN stair_steps = 3
IF riser_h <= 0 THEN riser_h = 0.18
IF post_d <= 0 THEN post_d = 0.20
IF tread_thk <= 0 THEN tread_thk = 0.04
IF tread_w <= 0 THEN tread_w = 0.05
IF total_angle = 0 THEN total_angle = 15
IF total_angle < -1440 THEN total_angle = -1440
IF total_angle > 1440 THEN total_angle = 1440
IF total_angle > -15 AND total_angle < 0 THEN total_angle = -15
IF total_angle > 0 AND total_angle < 15 THEN total_angle = 15

total_height = stair_steps * riser_h
step_angle = total_angle / stair_steps
outer_rx = A / 2
outer_ry = B / 2
inner_r = post_d / 2
available_radial_w = MIN(outer_rx, outer_ry) - inner_r
! Fixed: 使 A、B 增大时踏板几何同步扩展至声明的外包半径
effective_tread_w = MAX(tread_w, available_radial_w)
IF effective_tread_w < 0.001 THEN effective_tread_w = 0.001
tread_outer_rx = inner_r + effective_tread_w
tread_tangential_len = 2 * tread_outer_rx * SIN(step_angle / 2)
safe_tread_tangential_len = MAX(tread_tangential_len, tread_thk)

IF total_height + tread_thk > ZZYZX THEN ZZYZX = total_height + tread_thk

[FILE: scripts/3d.gdl]
TOLER 0.001

IF show_post THEN
    MATERIAL mat_post
    ! Fixed: 直接使用声明高度，确保中心柱包络匹配 ZZYZX
    CYLIND ZZYZX, post_d / 2
ENDIF

MATERIAL mat_tread

FOR i = 1 TO stair_steps
    ADDZ (i - 1) * riser_h
    ROT 0, 0, 1, (i - 1) * step_angle
    ADD inner_r, -safe_tread_tangential_len / 2, 0
    BLOCK effective_tread_w, safe_tread_tangential_len, tread_thk
    DEL 1
    DEL 1
    ! Fixed: 每轮循环包含 ADDZ、ROT、ADD 三个变换，补充删除 ADDZ 以避免高度累积为21.6
    DEL 1
NEXT i

END
